title: Disaster case management for fire survivors
summary: The county will take over the disaster case management program from the state in August, and survivors' case managers will stay the same. The program has made over 19,000 referrals, leading to over $173 million in services, and has closed 898 cases where households reached their recovery goals. The long-term recovery group now serves all disasters without funding for that and plans to ask the Council for help.
